text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! HBD to the B-day girl,<n>K.S.Miracle! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday. May you have a<n>wonderful year
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you sure you don't wanna<n>party? For you,
Miram, I'll assemble<n>a gajillion peeps!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's a lot of peeps. Where could<n>we fit a gajillion
people?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe there's such a venue<n>anywhere on
this planet.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Come ooon, don't you wanna let<n>loose?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you guys are too kind. The<n>sentiment is more
than enough for<n>me. It's the best present I could
ask<n>for.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...It's time to say another thank you...<n>to the
"miracle" that introduced me to<n>such kindness.
